title: quant_eval publication bundle: checksums.json
description: Per-file SHA-256 digests shipped in each quant_eval publication bundle (schema_version 1). Derived from published example publication bundles. `required` lists the fields present in every example. Every file listed under `files` must hash to `digest` and have length `bytes`; build_datasets.py aborts on any mismatch. The same objects are republished verbatim, keyed by run_id, under `bundles` in each dataset's source_bundle_checksums.json. build_datasets.py also accepts older flat shapes ({name: hex} or {name: {sha256|digest, bytes|size}}); those are not described here. algorithm.description: Digest algorithm. Always sha256 in the published bundles.

schema_version.description: Version of this checksum file layout. Observed value 1.

files.description: Map from a file name inside the publication bundle to its digest record. Keys are bare file names relative to the bundle directory.

digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal SHA-256 of the file's bytes.
